lines.text: You will turn your name into an animation that reacts when people click it.
Each letter of your name will be its own sprite.
When someone clicks a letter, it spins, grows, changes colour or makes a sound.
And the green flag puts every letter back to normal.
The first letter changes colour and pops. The second grows, waits, then shrinks back.
After lots of clicks, your letters might be big, upside down and rainbow coloured!
A reset script under the green flag puts each letter back, so your project always starts the same way.
Real programmers work in a cycle.
Plan, build a little, test it, fix it, and then share it.
Use the checklist as you work. Have fun, and be creative!
